scope: Read-only original/new CPU source and local ggml_is_contiguous definition; no build/kernel/model execution.

findings.finding: src1_cont is declared inside #if GGML_USE_LLAMAFILE in this function; the I2_S fast path using it is outside that conditional. Direct ggml_is_contiguous(src1) removes the out-of-scope identifier for non-LLAMAFILE builds.

Inside enabled LLAMAFILE builds, src1_cont is assigned exactly ggml_is_contiguous(src1), and its descriptor is const; the replacement gives the same Boolean test if that descriptor is not mutated externally. The reviewed ggml predicate only reads type/ne/nb.

No independent numerical kernel result, vector-dot equivalence, finite-output or tensor-layout boundary tests were run. Compilation and a model reply would not by themselves certify the I2_S kernel for all tensors.

Any patched static BitNet run must retain original shared-runtime failure and be labeled as a separate patched runtime. Its quality and timings are not directly an identical-backend comparison with mainline/Prism runs.
